comparator.name: Bachelor Architecture, Urbanism and Building Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The current 2026–2027 after-revision PER Article 3.4, required-course tables and Appendix 2, current-cohort webpage and Course Guide were freshly retrieved and inspected on 8 October 2026. AUDE is the first formal track and is selected by official order independently of UCR fit; no broadest/general/default route was established. Its first-year architectural project 7P4AB10 and later AUDE courses form one coherent route. Binder/Climber/Digger are indicative profiles, not additional compulsory tracks. The diagnostic below preserves every printed requirement: named core 125 EC, including 7P1B30 Multidisciplinary Project printed as 5 and 7A2B30 Bachelor End Project 10; ITEC 10; Appendix 2 electives 40 (15 year two, 25 year three). These 28 positions total 175, with years 60/60/55. They are explicitly not a verified 180-EC pathway. Article 3.4 instead requires at least 45 elective EC, whereas the current webpage describes core 130/ITEC10/electives40. Neither an extra 5 for the multidisciplinary project nor a new elective is invented to reconcile these authorities. Spanning two quarters does not establish a 10-EC project. The current entrant table uses 2MCALCBE in place of older 2WAB0. Appendix 3 pilot level requirements do not resolve the conflicting credit volumes. Elective approval, overlap and applicable level rules remain conditions. A bounded check of current official documents, the official project profile and catalogue access found no authoritative reconciliation; the catalogue was inaccessible and was not repeatedly retried. A corrected official requirement or university clarification is needed before the external reconstruction can be declared complete; no further automatic research round or monitoring is scheduled.
